> Official bilingual website for the original character Suzuko-chan.

- English: https://abcderp2.github.io/suzukochan.officialsite/en.html

## Access and use

AI visits are welcome. Search engines and AI services may read, index, summarize, cite, and link to public information for search results and user-requested answers.

This AI access statement does not itself grant additional permission for model training or other uses. Specific uses remain governed by the guidelines on the official site and the repository LICENSE. Suzuki retains the rights concerning the Suzuko-chan character, images, settings, and official status.
